correctness.rationale: The norm follows from exact summation by parts and a single-cut test. Equality forces transition-prefix equalities, yielding run-mass balance; an explicit epsilon construction proves positive norm-one masses with internal constraints. Every minimum-weight cut admits concentrated opposite-color masses approaching imbalance one, while only a two-run cut can attain equality. Rational checker independently compares 2026 weighted norms.
